name: Telnice (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly by a white band into a red upper hoist part bearing a blue twelve-pointed star and a green lower fly part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 21 June 1999 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
